name: Apep
body:
Known as the Seeker of Annihilation, Apep awaits the apocalypse to bring an end to all that is—he longs for all creation to revert to a great ocean of cosmic chaos.

Beginnings

Apep appears as a giant, 100-foot-long, green serpent. Anarchists and individuals who delight in entropy dedicate themselves to Apep.

Pandemonium

Granted Powers: Bedlam, anarchy, turmoil…these are the hallmarks of your magic.

With GM approval, a cleric with a chaotic evil deity can select this domain.

Dart of Confusion (Sp)

You can hurl a magical dart at a target within 30 feet. With a successful ranged touch attack, the target gains the confused condition for 1 round. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

Limbs to Snakes (Sp)

At 8th level, as a standard action, you can target a number of creatures equal to your Wisdom modifier that are within 60 feet of you. Both of the creature’s arms (maximum of 2 if the creature has several arms) turn into snakes and anything the creature was holding falls at its feet. (There is no save against this effect.) Each snake immediately makes a melee touch attack against the creature using your BAB plus your Wisdom modifier to hit. The snake bite is considered to be magical for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction and deals 1d6 piercing damage plus 1 point of poison damage for every two cleric levels you possess. After the snakes make their attacks (whether or not they were successful), the creature’s arms revert to normal. This ability has no effect on a creature without arms. You can use this ability once per day at 8th level, and an additional time per day for every six levels beyond 8th, to a maximum of three times at 20th level.

Domain: 1st-entropic shield, 2nd-shard of chaos, 3rd-mad monkeys, 4th-fleshworm infestation, 5th-hostile juxtaposition, greater, 6th-plague storm, 7th-summon monster Vll (bebelith and demons only such as vrock, succubus, babau), 8th-divine vessel (anarchic aspect only), 9th-maze of madness and suffering.
